name: F15: credits occur once for host and guest, the game's own homecoming save survives a quit and a title-screen reload
claim: ACCEPTANCE F15 (T3) §6.1 #3, with a REAL save witness: 'Credits occur once' and 'reload resumes a safe completed world with local requests, without a fifth key or invented sequel prompt', for HOST and GUEST. Setup stands in for PLAYING Tidewake to the end only (as f15_homecoming_credits_reload.json): the host's named Meadows save plus the end-of-Tidewake world facts committed through the ledger and Old Bram met. The harness's last save (capture_saves 'before') runs BEFORE the ending; after it, no harness step writes a save. save_witness reads each peer's character file through the game's own CharacterSave reader (never saving) and must see it REWRITTEN by the production homecoming transaction (homecoming_seen only) and again by the credits Continue (both receipts): without the game's own save_character calls these checks fail. Each peer then quits through session.leave (the game's quit save), and reloads through the production path: the host from the title screen (reset as a fresh process, Load Game, the autosave slot, Game.load_game, Meadows rebuilt and re-hosted), the guest through the title's returning route (its character file, JoinDriver). Per peer after the reload: both receipts, credits not pending, the repeat greeting, exactly two realm keys, no sequel prompt, local requests offered.
